name: Kanban Board
description: A drag-and-drop task board, unique per placement. Space editors organize work as cards in channel-colored columns: add, rename, recolor, and reorder columns, drag cards between them, and keep details and a short label on each card. Everyone else, including anyone the frame is shared with publicly, sees a live read-only view of the board. Cards and columns live in encrypted LocalTables scoped to the placement, and every change is pushed live to all viewers.
